about: Naigaon East is a fast-growing township and residential locality at the southern, closest-to-city end of the Vasai-Virar belt on the Western Railway, home to large affordable integrated townships, godown pockets and direct Western Express Highway access, with a green Tungareshwar-edge backdrop. It is served by Naigaon station between Vasai Road and Bhayandar.

faq.question: What is Naigaon East known for?
faq.answer: Naigaon East is known for being the closest of the Vasai-Virar belt to Mumbai city, its large wave of affordable new integrated townships, direct access to the Western Express Highway (NH-48), godown and warehouse pockets, and the green Tungareshwar-edge backdrop.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Naigaon East?
faq.answer: Naigaon East comes under pin code 401208, covering localities like Pragati Nagar, Vasant Nagari, Chimnpada and the new township belt.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Naigaon East?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Naigaon East are the New Township Belt, Pragati Nagar, Vasant Nagari, Chimnpada, the Highway Belt and the Station Road (east) belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Naigaon East?
faq.answer: Property prices in Naigaon East range from ₹26 lakh for a 1BHK near Chimnpada/Pragati Nagar to ₹45–65 lakh for a 2BHK in the new township belt, and ₹65–82 lakh for premium 2BHK/3BHK in larger gated complexes. Rental rates range from ₹7,000 to ₹16,000 per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Naigaon East?
faq.answer: Naigaon East is served by Naigaon station on Western Railway (between Vasai Road and Bhayandar), the closest of the Vasai-Virar belt to the city, with trains to Churchgate in about 45–60 minutes, plus direct road access to the Western Express Highway (NH-48), VVMC and ST feeder buses and abundant auto rickshaws.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Naigaon East?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Naigaon East include Cardinal Gracias Memorial Hospital (Vasai), Sai/Sparsh-style multispeciality hospitals, township-area trust hospitals and several VVMC and trust-run clinics serving the Pragati Nagar and Vasant Nagari belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Naigaon East?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Naigaon East include Podar/Universal-style CBSE schools, Vidya Vikas and St. Joseph-style schools, Marathi-medium VVMC schools and several CBSE and SSC schools serving the township and Pragati Nagar area.
